# Vendored spreadsheet library

`xlsx-0.20.3.min.js` is SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 (Apache-2.0).
Reused byte-for-byte from the established `financial-statements/vendor/xlsx-0.20.3.min.js`.
SHA-256: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`.
License retrieved from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SheetJS/sheetjs/master/LICENSE.

Used only to write customer-view XLSX downloads locally; no workbook upload or parsing
in the production UI, no CDN runtime dependency, no network export service.
